title: Optimize BM25 limited top-k search
constraints: Preserve full BM25 result ordering for existing callers
rationale: FusionStorage::bm25_search only returns the requested limit, but the underlying inverted index sorted all matching documents before Fusion truncated them. A limited top-k entry point keeps the full search_bm25 API intact while allowing limit-aware callers to avoid sorting the entire hit set.
steps: Add InvertedIndex::search_bm25_limited with a zero-limit fast path
Use select_nth_unstable_by to retain only top-k candidates before final ordering
Route FusionStorage::bm25_search through the limited search entry point
Add unit coverage that limited results match the full result prefix
expected_impact: Reduces BM25 result sorting work for hybrid and direct BM25 callers that request a small candidate limit.
